iiLevels.label: Dry weather
iiLevels.note: An ordinary day. Sewage only, plus a little groundwater.

iiLevels.label: Wet
iiLevels.note: Rain getting in through joints and defects. The network is stressed.

iiLevels.label: Very wet
iiLevels.note: A heavy event. Much of the trunk is already full before any growth.
